exact_guide_mm4_matched.policy: For each shared guide at four mismatches, first min(n_missed,n_returned) rows by original assay row_index in each arm.

control_selection.method: Lowest SHA-256 of aligned-control-v1<TAB>guide<TAB>chrom<TAB>strand<TAB>pam_coord; one locus per key, smallest DNA string on alignment ties; no score used.

cutoff.calibration_limit: Published CIRCLE-seq leave-one-guide-out cutoff; calibration for this combined-data checkpoint is not established.
cutoff.provenance: Lin et al. 2020 sensitivity analysis; carried over unchanged.
